order: Close out the two majors and the records item from the standing review verdict. Creation-time identity capture must fail closed, so have createCheckout resolve the checkout's canonical path itself and refuse the checkout, cleaning up the registration it just made, whenever that resolution fails; the lexical fallback then serves only already-gone swept paths, and the poisoned-realpath case gets pinned by a regression test. Replace the fixed sleeps in both review-lane kill branches, the SIGTERM branch and the SIGKILL branch, with a poll of git's own worktree registration lock, so each signal lands after the checkout has finished registering. A slow checkout stays locked past any fixed delay, and a kill arriving mid-registration leaves a locked worktree a single force cannot reclaim. Correct the records so the nine-of-nine green claim names the PR-head run and states the superseded run's true outcome, including the flake that fired. Record the verdict verbatim and hold the tranche at REVISE.
claims: All four items are done, with createCheckout resolving the canonical path itself and refusing the checkout on failure, and the poisoned-realpath regression pinned. Both kill branches, SIGTERM and SIGKILL, poll the new waitWorktreesUnlocked helper instead of sleeping a duration, and each asserts the checkout finished registering before its signal goes out; both new lock-condition checks pass. The records now name the PR-head run and the superseded run's true outcome. Suites ran green, with review-lane reporting 116 across two runs.
